title: 현재 사용중인 컴퓨터 사양을 알고 싶어요
content: ## Question * 현재 사용중인 컴퓨터 사양을 어떻게 확인할 수 있을까요? * 컴퓨터에 이상이 없는지 어떻게 확인하나요? * 내 그래픽 카드가 무엇인지 알고 싶어요. ## Answer * 일반적으로 잘 알려진 방법은 내 컴퓨터 > 우클릭 메뉴 > 속성을 선택하는 것입니다. * '**컴퓨터에 대한 기본 정보 보기** ' 화면에서는 CPU, 메모리, Windows 버전을 쉽게 확인할 수 있습니다. * 그래픽카드 정보, 자가 진단과 같은 자세한 정보는 아래에서 확인하세요. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360056607314) \-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ## Windows 사용자 * 내 컴퓨터 > 속성 * 시스템 정보 (msinfo32) * 바탕화면 우클릭 > Nvidia 제어판 > 속성 * DirectX 진단 도구 * 써드파티 프로그램 사용 ## Mac 사용자 * [이 Mac에 관하여](https://support.apple.com/ko-kr/HT201260) * About this Mac ## 같이 보기 * CLO 컴퓨터 권장사양 * 최적의 그래픽카드 선택 * 그래픽카드 드라이버 설치하기
content_description: 이 페이지는 사용자가 자신의 컴퓨터 사양, 그래픽 카드 정보, 그리고 시스템 점검 방법을 쉽게 확인할 수 있도록 안내합니다.

title: Adjust Trim Weight
content: **Adjust Trim Weight** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KHmDVSMQZ3o \- Apply weight to an OBJ trim to simulate 3D garment drape influenced by the trim. \- Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Transform Pattern/ Edit Pattern \- 2D Toolbar ▶ ![Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003329708/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png)**Transform Pattern/![Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003329728/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png) Edit Pattern** \- Select the OBJ loaded as a trim. \- Its properties appear in the Property Editor. \- Simulate after entering the desired value to the Weight option. \- The trim weight is applied to the Simulation.

title: Edit Block Folders in the Modular Configurator Window
content: ### **Objective** Edit Block folders at your convenience to organize Blocks in the folders. ** Location** Vertical Menu Tab on the Left ▶ Modular Configurator ▶ (Select) **Block Folder** ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Vertical Menu Tab on the Left ▶ Modular Configurator ▶ (Select) **Block Folder** → All Blocks in the selected Block folder appears in the Modular Configurator. 2. Select the ![edit_configurator.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026695168/edit_configurator.png) **Edit** button. → **Show** icons appear on every Garment thumbnails. 3. Select a Modular Structure file that you want to organize first. → All Blocks compatible with the selected Module Structure are now being displayed. 4. Click on the **Display** icon to either display or hide the Garments or Blocks → Hidden Garments or Blocks appear in lighter shade and the displayed Garments or Blocks appear in brighter shade. 5. Click on the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005619027/______.PNG) **Save** button to save in the configuration file in the same folder as the Block. 6. When editing is done, select the ![____3.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026695328/____3.png) **Exit** button. → The Blocks appear in the Modular Configurator accordingly. **※ Note: ** * It is able to tie the Modular configuration files as a group by adding a group in the Editor Mode when needing a category that is above all the Modular configuration files. * Unlikely to the Blocks, one Modular configuration file can only be included in one group.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide a step-by-step guide for users to efficiently edit and organize Block folders within the Modular Configurator.

content: ### **Objective** Adjust **Intensity** and **Thickness** of 3D seamlines to render a realistic Garment. ** Location ** Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ **Edit Sewing ** 3D/2D Toolbar ▶ ![edit_sewing.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024256947/edit_sewing.png) **Edit Sewing** ** Operation ** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. 2. Select a Sewing Line. → Properties of the Sewing Line appears in the Property Editor. 3. Adjust the settings below as needed: **Option** | **Description** ---|--- [**Normal Map**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000447607) **(ver 5.2)** | Select an image to be used as the Normal Map. **Intensity (%)** | Adjust the intensity of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. **Thickness** | Adjust the thickness of the Normal Map applied to the seamline.

title: Layer
content: **List of Contents** Layer Set Layer **Layer** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jSKSGF9r-dI \- Set the order of Layers to easily simulate layered 3D Garments. \- Navigate to the Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ **Layer.** ** ****Set Layer** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0iDh933y9M0 \- Using the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022754007/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool, select the Pattern to be edited. \- Navigate to the Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ **Layer.** \- Type in the value for the Layer option. Assign the greater value to the Patterns layered outwards. \- When the Layer value is assigned, the selected Patterns will be highlighted in neon green. \- Simulate to apply the setting. When Garments are completely simulated, reflecting the Layer setting, turn off the Simulation and reset Layer values of all Patterns to 0. \- When Layer values is 0, Patterns are simulated according to the order placed in the 3D window. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on managing layer settings for simulating layered 3D garments, complete with instructional videos and step-by-step instructions.

title: Delete Curve Point
content: **Objective** Delete unnecessary curve points when editing Patterns. When all curve points on a segment is deleted, it turns to a straight line. ** Location** **Delete Selected** Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ **Edit Curve Point** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001140388/________.png) **Edit Curve Point** **Delete All ** Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) ▶ **Delete All Curve Points** ** Operation** **Delete Selected** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ **Edit Curve Point** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001140388/________.png) **Edit Curve Point** 2. title: Unfold
content: ### **Objective** Unfold a half pattern as a full pattern with no center line or seam. ### **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CwB8_ad328M?si=NtcMsisnB9xq_Ge_ &start=1988** ### ** ****Location** ### Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ **Edit Pattern** ### 2D Toolbar ▶ **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001059728/2.png)****Edit Pattern** ### **Operation** 1. Click the tool/menu indicated. 2. Right-click on the fiducial segment of the pattern, and click **Unfold** menu. → The selected pattern and internal polygon are unfolded symmetrically. 3. Or if you only want to unfold the pattern except for the internal lines or base lines, click **Unfold Pattern Outline Only** menu. → Only the pattern unfolds, with the internal polygons and baselines located on one side. (ver 7.2) **※Note:** You can unfold multiple patterns at once by selecting the center lines of the patterns at the same time. (ver 7.2)

title: Subsurface Scattering Material
content: **Objective** Realistically express human skin. Subsurface Scattering Material penetrates and scatters under the objects' surface. Utilize the material to illustrate leaves, fruit, candles and more. Application results are only be viewed in the [Render ](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014784747-Run-V-Ray-Render)window. [Watch Tutorial Video](https://youtu.be/myqp2Li8FiI) **Location** Fabric Property Editor ▶ Material ▶ Type ▶ **Skin (Render Only)** ** Operation** 1. Select the menu/tool indicated.** ****** 2. Refer to the table below to edit the properties. **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- **Mix** | Adjust the value of Subsurface Scattering (in which light is scattered by penetrating objects). If the value is 0, the material is not applied and is reflected only on the surface of the object. If the value is 1, it is applied to the maximum extent and does not reflect on the surface of the object. **Mix Map**(ver 7.1) | Apply a Mix Map to partially apply the amount of subsurface scattering. **Density Scale** | Adjust the size property of an object to adjust the extent to which SSS is applied. The smaller the value, the wider the SSS coverage. **※ Note:** The Density Scale is applied by multiplying/sharing of each layer radius value, so adjust only the size to which SSS is applied while maintaining the radius ratio between the three layers. **Shallow / Medium / Deep ** | Adjust the properties of the three layers of subsurface scattering to express composite materials. Color | Set the color of the light to be scattered. Color Map | Use a map to express the desired color in the desired area. Weight | The weight of the layer sets the intensity of the color and map of the layer that is set against the other layer. If the value is 1, it has the highest weight. Radius | Set the radius in which each layer scatters inside the surface of the object. 3. Start the [Render](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/115014784747-V-Ray-%EB%A0%8C%EB%8D%94-%EC%8B%A4%ED%96%89) window. → Subsurface Scattering Material materials are applied. **※ Note:** When two or more meshes are overlapped, SSS materials can appear abnormally. Therefore, take the overlapped meshes off each other using other 3D programs, or import the meshes separately and apply SSS materials. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360097836353/mceclip0.png)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on utilizing Subsurface Scattering Material to realistically render human skin and other organic materials in 3D applications.

title: How to Fix the Error using Intel Graphics Card
content: **List of Contents** Case 1 Case 2 (If the error is not resolved by Case 1) Objective Learn how to resolve launching error using Intel HD Graphics. Operation Since this crashing is due to a Graphic driver which is automatically updated by Microsoft Windows, please re-install the Intel graphics driver after deactivating "Windows Automatic Updates". Case 1 1. Please input "gpedit.msc" on Search tool and execute it. 2. Local Group Policy Editor ▶ Computer Configuration ▶ Administrative Templates ▶ Windows Components ▶ Windows Updates ▶ activate "Do not include drivers with Windows Update" ![image_1_1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003369948/image_1_1.png)**※ Note:** The option may not appear in the Window versions below. In this case, External Graphics card should be used. (Please refer to [Computer Specification](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000307168-Computer-Specifications)) Windows 7 Home Edition / Windows 10 Home Edition 3. Device Manager ▶ Display Adapters ▶ Intel(R) HD Graphic ▶ Uninstall the device and driver software ▶ Reboot Windows ![image_2_1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003447047/image_2_1.png) 4. Enter [Intel Support Page](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/intel-driver-support-assistant.html) and download and install the program of Intel® Driver & Support Assistant. 5. Start scanning the driver. 6. Download and Reinstall the driver of Intel(R) HD Graphics. 7. Verify the "23.20.16.4901" version is installed correctly.![image_3.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003369968/image_3.png) 8. Please reboot Windows. 9. If the Error is not resolved with Case 1, please proceed Case 2 below. **Case 2** If the Error is not resolved with Case 1, please proceed Case 2. 1. Please enter [Intel® Graphics Driver for Windows*](https://downloadcenter.intel.com/download/27412/Graphics-Intel-Graphics-Driver-for-Windows-15-60-?wapkw=hd+graphic) and Download & Install the driver. 2. Approve overwrite to the previous version during Installation. ![image_3_1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003369988/image_3_1.png) Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides step-by-step instructions for resolving launching errors related to Intel HD Graphics by managing driver installations and Windows update settings.

title: Polygon
content: **List of Contents** Polygon Create Polygon Create Polygon with Curves Create Polygon with Specific Values Create Points in Guidelines Cancel the Last Action Cancel All Actions **Polygon** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Uti_3pcl_Tc \- Create Polygon Patterns in the 2D window. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022648248/mceclip0.png) **Polygon** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Or, navigate to the Main Menu and select 2D Pattern ▶ Create ▶ **Polygon.** ** Create Polygon** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j6Pi66_PVQQ \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022648248/mceclip0.png) **Polygon** tool and click on the 2D window to draw desired shape of Polygon. \- Click the start point again to complete the Pattern. **Create Polygon with Curves** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7pzr1ZXjZ5Q \- Hold down the Ctrl key while clicking the 2D window to create curves with the free curve point. \- Or, click and drag the mouse while adding a point on the 2D window to create curves with AI Bezier handles. **Create Polygon with Specific Values** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bhp9XaIe_34 \- Click and then right click on the 2D window to access the Create Polygon window. \- Type in the desired value to Length. **Create Points in Guidelines** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1qiaU65EdiU \- Hold down the Shift key on the keyboard to add points in a straight line or a diagonal line. **Cancel the Last Action** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AYTWW0AnB34 \- While creating the Polygon Pattern, hit the Delete key on the keyboard to cancel the last action. **Cancel All Actions** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EZYAyQAbwcc \- While creating the Polygon Pattern, hit the Esc or Ctrl+Z keys on the keyboard to cancel all actions. View the hierarchy of subfolders in the added folder as tree view. **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005506048/____.png)Refresh** | Apply any changes made in the Library such as deleting or adding folders. **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005506028/___.png)List /![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005506108/___.png) Icon** | Toggle between different views. **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005506008/rjator.png)Search** | Use Search to locate files quickly and efficiently within the Library. ** ※ Note:** * Hover over the desired Project/Garment file thumbnail to preview font, back, and side views. * To change the thumbnail image of a folder in the Library window, please open the corresponding folder installed on your computer. content_description: "Effortlessly manage and access your files with the Library Window, featuring customizable folder shortcuts, quick search capabilities, and intuitive drag-and-drop functionality."

title: Express Double Sided
content: ### **Objective** Without putting two Patterns together, it is able to express double sided effect. **Location** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005494667/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png) **Edit Pattern** / ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005494687/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png) **Transform Pattern** **Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005494667/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png) **Edit Pattern** / ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005494687/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png) **Transform Pattern ** 2. Select a Pattern or Pattern line to express doubled sided effect. → Its properties appear in the Property Editor. 3. Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Curved Side Geometry ▶ Check on **Double Sided** → The selected Pattern or Pattern line is now being displayed as double sided.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide to enabling a double-sided effect for patterns using the 2D Toolbar in CLO 3D.

title: Curved Side Geometry
content: ### **Objective** Apply and adjust curvature on edges of Patterns for more natural and realistic look (ver2.2.0). **Location** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005541708/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png) **Transform Pattern** / ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005494467/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png) **Edit Pattern** **Operation** 1. Firstly, change the 3D Garment rendering style to **Thick Textured Surface** in the 3D window. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar **▶![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005541708/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png) Transform Pattern** **/![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005494467/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png) Edit Pattern**** ** 3. Select a Pattern or Pattern line to express curved sided effect. → Its properties appear in the Property Editor. 4. Enter a desired value at: Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Curved Side Geometry ▶ **Curvature (%) ** → The curvature is now being applied according to the entered value. **※ Note:** The maximum **Curvature (%)** value is 50 percent (%) of the fabric thickness. For instance, if the fabric thickness is being set at 1mm, the maximum **Curvature (%)** is 0.5mm.
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide to applying and adjusting curvature on pattern edges for a more natural and realistic appearance in CLO 3D.

title: Topstitch Right-Click Pop-Up Menu
content: **Topstitch Right-Click Pop-Up Menu** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AXkiCvHl7-A \- Right click on the Topstitch to access the right-click pop-up menu. \- Select ![Toolbar_Common_Stitch_Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003315248/Toolbar_Common_Stitch_Edit.png)**Edit Topstitch** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Right click on the Topstitch and select the desired option from the right-click pop-up menu. * **Select All With Same Property** * Select all Topstitches that have the same property with clicked Topstitch. * **Assign to New Topstitch** * Apply a new Topstitch style to selected Topstitch. * A new Topstitch style is added and applied to selected Topstitch. * **Delete** * Delete selected Topstitch. * **D. Add Internal Line on Topstitch _ver4.2.0** * An Internal Line is created on top of selected Topstitch.
content_description: Explore the features and functionalities of the Topstitch right-click pop-up menu through our informative YouTube video, guiding you on how to efficiently edit, select, assign, and manage Topstitches in your design projects.

title: Transform OBJ Trims
content: **List of Contents** Via the Scale Gizmo Via the Property Editor **Objective** Transform OBJ files loaded as trim as needed. **Location ** **Via the Scale Gizmo ** Load OBJ as Trim ▶ ![scale_gizmo.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024298848/scale_gizmo.png) **Scale Via the Property Editor **Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ **Select/Move ** 3D Toolbar**▶![Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024215067/Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png) Select/Move** ** Operation** **Via the Scale Gizmo** 1. [Load an OBJ](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000494107). 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Load OBJ as Trim ▶ ![scale_gizmo.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024298848/scale_gizmo.png) **Scale** → The **Scale Gizmo** appears. 3. Click and drag on the x,y, or z-axis to transform the OBJ. **Axis** | **Description** ---|--- **X-Axis** | The red axis of the Gizmo. Click and drag the x-axis to transform the OBJ trim along its x-axis. **Y-Axis** | The yellow-green axis of the Gizmo. Click and drag the y-axis to transform the OBJ trim along its y-axis. **Z-Axis** | The blue axis of the Gizmo. Click and drag the z-axis to transform the OBJ along its z-axis. **Square** | The yellow square located in the center of the **Scale Gizmo**. Click and drag the square to transform the OBJ trim, while maintaining its x, y, and z ratio. → The OBJ is transformed. 4. When the OBJ transformation is complete, click the ![scale_gizmo.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024298848/scale_gizmo.png) **Scale** button again. → The **Gizmo** used for moving and rotating OBJs appears. **Via the Property Editor ** 1. [Load an OBJ](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000494107). 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ **Select/Move ** 3D Toolbar**▶![Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024215067/Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png) Select/Move ** 3. Select the OBJ to be transformed. → The properties of the OBJ appear in the Property Editor. 4. Find the **Scale** option. 5. Enter the desired value for below options. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **X-Axis** | Enter the desired x-axis value. **Y-Axis** | Enter the desired y-axis value. **Z-Axis** | Enter the desired z-axis value. **Maintain Ratio** | Toggle this option on to adjust an OBJ while maintaining its x, y, and z ratio. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides step-by-step instructions on how to transform OBJ files using the Scale Gizmo and Property Editor in CLO 3D.

title: Strengthen
content: **List of Contents** Strengthen Result of Strengthen **Strengthen** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZCWi0Vffau4 \- Temporarily harden Patterns while simulating the 3D Garment. \- Strengthen when folding or straightening Patterns in the 3D window. \- Use the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022739767/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool to select patterns, right click, and select **Strengthen. ** Windows Shortcut: Ctrl + H Mac Shortcut: Ctrl + L (ver5.0.0)** ** ** Result of Strengthen** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zwhNz339xlo \- When the Patterns are strengthened properly, they turn orange. \- The Patterns will temporarily gain strength and express clean folds where fold angles are applied. \- To unstrengthen the Pattern, use the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022739767/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool to select Pattern, right click, and select **Unstrengthen. ** Windows Shortcut: Ctrl + H Mac Shortcut: Ctrl + L (ver5.0.0) Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: Explore the features and functionalities of the "Strengthen" tool in 3D garment simulation, including video tutorials and step-by-step instructions for enhancing pattern integrity.

title: Video Capture 3D Garment (Turntable)
content: **List of Contents** Record Quit **Objective** Easily record 3D garments with Turntable, utilize it when communicating. YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ko3ssVpNffQ ** Location** **Record** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Video Capture ▶ **Turntable** **Quit** X button on the top-right corner of Turntable dialogue ▶ **X Button** ** Operation** **Record** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. → Turntable dialogue window appears at the bottom-right corner. 2. Set options as needed and start recording. ** Video Size ** | Adjust the orientation, width and height of the turntable video window. ---|--- ** Options ** | Rotation Axis (ver 6.1) | Set the rotation axis of a Turntable video. Auto | The axis is set to the center of the garment and avatar in the 3D window. Center (0.0) | The axis is set to the center (0.0) in the 3D window. title: [2D Tool] M:N Free Sewing
content: **Objective** Freely establish Sewing Lines on Pattern outlines and Internal Shapes/Lines to sew multiple Patterns (M) to multiple Patterns (N) at once. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ **M:N Free Sewing** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005448927/M_N________.png) **M:N Free Sewing** **※ Note:** Hold down the **Free Sewing** tool for a while to access the **M:N Free Sewing** Tool. ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ **M:N Free Sewing** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005448927/M_N________.png) **M:N Free Sewing** 2. Establish Free Sewing Lines on multiple Patterns, which are considered as M Patterns. 3. Hit the Enter key on the keyboard to complete. → The Sewing Lines appear in neon color. 4. While being mindful of Directional Notches, establish Sewing Lines on Patterns which are sewn to M Patterns. Hit the Enter key on the keyboard to complete M:N Sewing Lines. → All Sewing Lines no longer appear in neon color. **※ Note:** * While establishing the Sewing Lines, hit the Delete key on the keyboard to cancel the last action or hit the Esc key on the keyboard to cancel all actions. * While establishing M:N sewing lines, if you click on an inappropriate segment, the segment appears in red and the Sewing Line cannot be applied. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to utilize the M:N Free Sewing tool to efficiently establish sewing lines across multiple patterns in the 2D Toolbar.
